question: Can I take a break from uni, and for how long?
answer:
A student in good academic standing may be granted a leave of absence for up to three consecutive semesters/one academic year [Page 218]. A student applying for a leave of absence must give a definite semester for re-registration and must register in the following semester, immediately after the leave period [Page 218].

If a student is in good academic standing but remains absent without prior permission, they may be approved for a leave of absence on compassionate ground by the Vice Chancellor for one semester with a penalty of 20% of the 9 credits tuition; two consecutive semesters with a penalty of 30% of the 9 credits tuition; or three consecutive semesters with a penalty of 40% of the 9 credits tuition [Page 218]. If the span of unauthorized absence exceeds three consecutive semesters/one academic year, no permission shall be accorded and the student will be “Officially Withdrawn” from the university [Page 218].

Students who are on probation or subject to dismissal are not allowed to drop a semester or to take leave of absence [Page 217]. However, if a student after completing the first semester of probation (1 out of 2 semesters) asks for leave/drop on extreme compassionate ground, he/she may be granted leave/drop for the 2nd semester of probation considering his/her improved result achieved in the first semester of probation [Page 218]. Additionally, students who are on probation and remain absent without prior permission may, in some special cases, be allowed leave by the Vice Chancellor maximum for one semester with his discretion with 20% penalty of 9 credits tution fees [Page 218] [Page 215].

A newly admitted student might be granted a leave of absence for the first semester on compassionate ground [Page 218].

question: What GPA do I need to graduate, and what if mine goes under 2?
answer: To graduate from an undergraduate program, you must earn at least a minimum CGPA of 2.00 [Page 25]. If your CGPA is between 1 and 2 after the first two or any subsequent semesters, you will be placed on probation for the next two semesters [Page 217]. Failure to raise your CGPA to at least 2 after the probation period will lead to dismissal from the university [Page 217]. If a student’s CGPA falls below 2 subsequently, he/she will again be placed on probation [Page 217].

question: When do I get put on probation vs kicked out?
answer:
A student will be placed on probation if their CGPA is between 1 and 2 after the first two or any subsequent semesters [Page 217]. Students who fail to pass in remedial courses in two attempts will also be placed on probation [Page 217].

A student will be automatically dismissed from the university if their CGPA falls below 1.0 after the first two or any subsequent semesters [Page 217]. Students who are placed on probation will face dismissal if they fail to raise their CGPA to satisfactory levels during the probation period [Page 217]. Specifically, failure to raise a CGPA to at least 2 after the probation period (irrespective of whether s/he is a regular student or remains absent without authorization) will lead to dismissal from the university [Page 217].
